automatic_acceptance.STRUCTURED_DIRECT_HASH_RESOLVED: candidate-local structured historical record contains an explicit hash/digest field that identifies exactly one external function
automatic_acceptance.STRUCTURED_HASH_NAME_RESOLVED: candidate-local structured record supplies hash evidence and candidate-linked function name evidence whose conjunction identifies exactly one external function
